title: 第78章 挖出宝了

第78章 挖出宝了-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

当天，工地上的战斗正式打响。

一九七一年，全国都在“深挖洞、广积粮”。北京城到处是工地，机关、学校、工厂、街道，人人上阵，家家参与。恭王府这一片，因为地势高、土层厚、位置隐蔽，被划成了重点开挖地段。后院假山区域，石头多，挖起来最费劲，但防空效果最好，所以任务段就定在了这里。

此地当时属公安家属院，日常施工没人盯着深层结构，正好契合了王建新心里的那个念头——他知道，这下面有东西。

开工第一天，刘晓东抡起铁镐，一镐下去，土层只裂了一条缝。他甩了甩震麻的双手，呲牙咧嘴地说：“这土比我们老家的硬多了。”

郭强接过铁镐，闷声抡了几下，土层开始松动，但他的手掌很快磨出了血泡，疼得直甩手。李建国蹲在地上，用卷尺量着挖好的深度，喊了一嗓子：“这边还差三十公分，再往下挖一层！”

周小梅和陈秀英负责往地面运土。两人一把铁锹，把挖出来的土装进柳条筐里，再用绳子拉到地面。柳条筐沉得很，一筐土几十斤，两个人拉得脸都红了。这种人拉肩扛的作业方式，是那个年代防空洞建设的基本操作，没什么机械，全靠人力。

王建新没急着干活。他站在坑边，看似在观察土层，实际上神识早就探了下去。

恭王府后院假山根部，滴翠岩下方的土层，深度在三米五左右。神识穿透泥土、碎石、夯土层，一路往下，触到了一层坚硬的青砖。青砖后面是空的。

密室。

神识探进去的瞬间，王建新的心跳快了一拍。里面码着成堆的金条、金元宝、金银器皿、玉饰、珠宝，还有清代银锭。整整齐齐，没有腐烂，没有受潮，保存完好。这就是和珅当年来不及被嘉庆抄走、藏在假山山体暗层里的遗留珍宝。传说中那些“什锦窗”对应的宝藏，有一部分就在这里。

Chapter 78: Digging up a treasure - "In the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune from zero-yuan purchases"

That day, the battle on the construction site officially started.

In 1971, the whole country was "digging holes deeply and accumulating grain widely."Beijing is full of construction sites, offices, schools, factories, and streets. Everyone is involved, and every family is involved.The area of ​​Prince Gong's Mansion was designated as a key excavation area due to its high terrain, thick soil layer, and hidden location.There are many rocks in the backyard rockery area, which is the most laborious to dig, but the air defense effect is the best, so the mission section is set here.

This place was a police home at the time, and no one was paying attention to the deep structure during daily construction. This fit perfectly with Wang Jianxin's idea - he knew there was something underneath.

On the first day of construction, Liu Xiaodong swung the pickaxe and when the pickaxe came down, there was only a crack in the soil.He shook his numb hands and grinned, "The soil here is much harder than the soil in our hometown."

Guo Qiang took the pickaxe and swung it a few times with a muffled sound. The soil began to loosen, but blood blisters soon appeared on his palm, and he shook his hand in pain.Li Jianguo squatted on the ground, measured the dug depth with a tape measure, and shouted: "There is still thirty centimeters left here, dig another layer!"

Zhou Xiaomei and Chen Xiuying are responsible for transporting soil to the ground.The two of them used a shovel to put the excavated soil into a wicker basket, and then used a rope to pull it to the ground.The wicker basket was very heavy, weighing dozens of kilograms of soil. The two people were so embarrassed that their faces turned red.This work method of people pulling on shoulders was the basic operation of air-raid shelter construction in that era. There was no machinery and it relied entirely on manpower.

Wang Jianxin was in no hurry to work.He stood at the edge of the pit, seemingly observing the soil, but in fact his spiritual consciousness had already penetrated it.

At the base of the rockery in the backyard of Prince Gong's Mansion, the depth of the soil beneath the Didui Rock is about three and a half meters.His spiritual consciousness penetrated the soil, gravel, and rammed earth layers, all the way down, and touched a layer of hard blue bricks.There is nothing behind the blue bricks.

Secret room.

The moment his spiritual consciousness penetrated, Wang Jianxin's heart beat a beat faster.Inside are piles of gold bars, gold ingots, gold and silver utensils, jade ornaments, jewelry, and Qing Dynasty silver ingots.Neat, no rot, no moisture, well preserved.This is the treasure He Shen left behind that was not confiscated by Jiaqing in time and was hidden in the dark layer of the rockery.Some of the treasures corresponding to the legendary "Assorted Window" are located here.
